summary: Prospective claim ceiling defined: PR-176 may emit only a roadmap_rescue_v1:C3 conditional, standard_internal, public_use=false statement that theta=div(v) is an estimand structurally distinct from the bulk-flow dipole and radial-monopole estimator, while explicitly not immune to shared leakage. This is not an implementation or scientific-result verdict.

claim_ceiling.allowed_statement: Under the preregistered frame, transfer declaration, channel-wise injection, and conservative dependence contract, the measured theta=div(v) channel is structurally distinct from the bulk-flow dipole and radial-monopole estimators; it is not immune to shared leakage. Any retained output is an internal conditional cross-channel falsifier only.
claim_ceiling.pre_pr155_limit: Before PR-155, even an informative output is limited to a channel-wise falsifier with a conservative dependence bound; it is not a joint detection or physical attribution.

forbidden_language_or_inference: Do not turn scalar theta or div(v) into an apex, preferred axis, or directional localization claim.
Do not call the result a detection, signal discovery, null validation, significance claim, or leakage immunity result.
Do not infer global tilt, cosmological anisotropy, physical acceleration, or a local-versus-global mechanism from this cross-channel relation.
Do not claim Bianchi geometry, morphology-family identification, or any Bianchi family ranking.
Do not call any external or AniCLASS transfer a native solver result, native-transfer validation, or authenticated native delivery.
Do not merge div(v) with the bulk-flow dipole or reduce the test to two remeasurements of one dipole estimand.
Do not tune lambda or an axis after inspecting coherence; that requires a new preregistered analysis.

conditional_falsifier_eligible_only_if: theta=div(v), the bulk-flow dipole, and the radial-monopole estimator remain separately identified estimands
a preregistered channel-wise injection demonstrates an informative q-response rather than merely substituting the ad-hoc closure
frame and transfer source are declared
the registered dependence treatment is valid and the channel is not near-rigid translation
mandatory_NON_INFORMATIVE_if_any: the preregistered q-response is absent, invalid, or not demonstrated by channel-wise injection
matched/joint covariance is unavailable, invalid, or remains unidentified
the estimands cannot be kept distinct or the dependence bound is invalid
terminal_routing.NON_INFORMATIVE_meaning: A valid terminal scientific result under this card; it must not be rewritten as evidence for or against a physical signal, global tilt, geometry, family, or native transfer.

Pre-native solver boundary, transfer-conditional language, OBSSTAT ownership limit, family-identification firewall, forbidden native/geometry language, and mandatory artifact metadata.

findings.summary: The allowed claim is structural distinction without immunity, conditional and internal at C3; absent q-response or matched/joint covariance, invalid dependence, or near-rigid translation forces NON_INFORMATIVE.
